- Install vehicle lighting and wiring systems
- Install ancillary electronic systems and components

- Using readings to find faults

- Repairing or replacing faulty parts
- Retesting the system to make sure everything is working correctly and safely
- Road tests of vehicles to test proper functionality of on board electronics

result.description: Singh Logistics Perth Pty Ltd  Singh Logistics Perth Pty Ltd is seeking reliable and experienced Truck Drivers / Concrete Agitator Drivers to join its growing transport team in Caversham, Western Australia.  The business provides concrete delivery services across the Perth metropolitan area and is expanding its operations due to increased client demand. The company is currently recruiting to fill multiple existing vacancies and support ongoing workforce needs. The successful candidates will be responsible for safely operating heavy vehicles, including concrete agitator trucks, to load, transport and deliver concrete to construction sites and client locations in accordance with road safety, site safety and company requirements.   Benefits   Full-time, stable employment with a growing transport business  Competitive salary plus superannuation  Consistent work across Perth metropolitan areas  Supportive and safety-focused work environment  Opportunity to work with modern heavy vehicles and concrete delivery equipment  Long-term role within an expanding logistics and construction supply operation    Task & responsibilities   Safely drive and operate heavy vehicles, including concrete agitator trucks, for concrete delivery across Perth and surrounding areas  Conduct daily pre-start checks and inspect vehicles to ensure they are safe, roadworthy and ready for operation  Load, mix, transport and discharge concrete safely and efficiently at customer and construction sites  Manoeuvre vehicles safely into position for loading, unloading and on-site delivery  Follow delivery schedules, route plans and instructions from dispatch or site supervisors  Ensure concrete is delivered in a timely manner while maintaining product quality and safety standards  Complete delivery dockets, logbooks, vehicle checklists and other required paperwork accurately  Follow all road transport laws, workplace health and safety procedures, and site-specific safety rules  Communicate professionally with customers, site staff, dispatchers and other team members  Report vehicle faults, hazards, delays, incidents or unusual traffic conditions to management  Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the truck and related equipment  Comply with load, weight, fatigue management and heavy vehicle safety requirements  Work safely around construction sites, concrete plants and customer delivery locations    Qualification & experience   AQF Certificate II or III in Road Transport, Driving Operations or a related field, or equivalent relevant heavy vehicle driving experience  Minimum one year of relevant heavy vehicle driving experience  Valid and current Heavy Rigid (HR) driver licence or higher  White Card / Construction Induction Card  Previous concrete agitator truck driving experience is highly regarded  Good knowledge of Western Australian road rules, transport safety and site safety requirements  Ability to safely operate heavy vehicles in metropolitan and construction site environments  Good communication skills and ability to deal professionally with customers and site personnel  Ability to complete paperwork, delivery records and vehicle checklists accurately  Reliable, punctual and safety-focused attitude  Ability to work independently and as part of a team  Physical ability to perform duties associated with heavy vehicle and concrete delivery work  Willingness to undergo drug and alcohol testing if required   About Company     Singh Logistics Perth Pty Ltd is a Western Australian transport business providing concrete delivery and logistics services across the Perth metropolitan area. The business supports clients in the construction and concrete supply industries and is continuing to grow due to ongoing demand for reliable concrete delivery services.    The company is seeking committed and experienced drivers to support its current operations, and near-future workforce needs while maintaining safe, reliable and professional delivery services for its customers.
